scope: Static review of existing local LiteLLM backend source snapshots; no backend was executed or contacted.
snapshot_origin: litellm-m4-claude/stream-slots/{paas-full,ha-full}; pre-existing patch-chain source evidence, not a new image extraction
identity_limit: Bundle pins are recorded provenance from the previous lane. This review hashes current local source bytes; it does not independently re-extract an image or certify any service uses these bytes.

litellm/proxy/health_endpoints/_health_e.observation: GET /health runs probes unless a cached/background path applies; a configured model and Prisma can save health history.

litellm/proxy/health_check.py.observation: Health check dispatch calls ahealth_check with test prompt/input.

litellm/proxy/proxy_server.py.observation: Token counter defaults call_endpoint=False. MCP leaves it unset; local tokenizer selection/counting is used.

litellm/proxy/spend_tracking/spend_manag.observation: Spend calculator delegates to completion_cost; does not dispatch inference or post a billing transaction.

litellm/cost_calculator.py.observation: Cost calculation can count tokens from supplied messages/text when usage is absent.

litellm/utils.py.observation: Tokenizer selection can use from_pretrained unless downloads are disabled/cached.

litellm/litellm_core_utils/token_counter.observation: Image token counting can fetch remote image bytes to determine dimensions.

decision.meaning: Existing active-work permission bucket, not a claim all three mutate configuration or bill inference.
decision.legacy_read_denies: For these three tools only, legacy read denies also deny create.

validation: Real MCP callbacks/HA gateway policy and PaaS proxy operation policy, fake HTTPX backends; no external provider calls.
